name: memory-semantic
description: Human-labeled cases chosen specifically because deterministic lexical matching does NOT solve them: unfamiliar paraphrased contradictions, indirect negation, same-dimension value substitutions, plus safety negatives (unrelated surface similarity, different subjects/scopes, temporary instructions, secrets, financial facts, and inert lifecycle records). Each case declares the existing memory, the new statement, memory type, subject, scope, authority, the SAFE expected outcome, whether human review is required, and whether supersession is allowed. The runner executes the REAL write pipeline; a case's safety fields must never be violated at any detector setting.
